Metadata.description: How much of each payment is not yours, what you owe and when. Figures from the GestorIA engine.

Shell.disclaimer: GestorIA is a personal tool, not tax advice. Check anything important with a gestor or the AEAT.

Dashboard.title: Overview
Dashboard.lead: How much of each payment you receive is not yours, and what falls due next.

profile.missingLead: Enter it once in Settings. Every estimate here is computed from it.

Dashboard.basis: Estimated from your profile for {year}, with no closed quarter recorded: the projection covers the whole year.

estimate.heading: Estimate
estimate.holdBack: Hold back {share} of every payment you receive.
estimate.localHolidays: Municipal holidays are not applied, so the date can be early but never late.
estimate.cuota: TGSS cuota per month this quarter
estimate.renta: Renta on top of the Modelo 130 advances

notices.heading: Read these before relying on the figures

trace.heading: How it was calculated
trace.lead: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} in the engine's order, grouped by section. Titles, formulas and sources are the engine's own.

Payments.title: Payments
Payments.lead: Everything you pay to Hacienda and the Seguridad Social, in date order.

points.obligations: Every obligation: Modelo 130, 303 and 349, the monthly TGSS cuota and the Renta true-up.
points.amounts: The amount when it is known, and a clear “not known yet” when it is not.
points.windows: The window for each payment after the weekend and regional holiday rules. Local holidays are not applied.
points.history: Past obligations with what was due, and an export of the dates to your calendar app.

Payments.pending: This needs the payment calendar and the quarterly and annual calculations from the API, which are not built yet.

Transactions.title: Transactions
Transactions.lead: The money that actually moved: what came in and what went out.

profile.missingLead: Statements are imported into your taxpayer profile. Enter it in settings first.

import.heading: Import a bank statement
import.lead: Export the statement from your bank as CSV. Importing the same statement again, or one that overlaps it, adds only the movements not stored yet.
import.done: {lines, plural, one {# movement read} other {# movements read}}: {imported} new, {already} already imported.

list.heading: Movements in {year}
list.label: Movements
list.empty: No movements match. Import a statement or pick another period.

failure.network: The API is not answering. Is it running?
failure.database: The GestorIA database is not answering. Start it with docker compose up -d postgres and try again.
failure.refused: The statement was not imported, nothing was stored:
failure.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB. Export a shorter period.
failure.other: The API answered with an error ({status}).

Periods.title: Periods
Periods.lead: Quarters and tax years, each with its results.

points.quarters: Each quarter's Modelo 130 and 303 results with their casilla numbers.
points.years: Each tax year's annual result (Renta) and how it was reached.
points.trace: The step-by-step calculation, grouped by section.

Periods.pending: This needs the quarterly and annual calculations from the API, which are not built yet.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.lead: Language, theme, your profile and your data, in one place.

profile.heading: Your taxpayer profile
profile.privacy: Saved in the GestorIA database on this machine, not in the browser. The overview estimates from it.
profile.gaps: Not published yet in the {year} configuration. An estimate that needs one of these is refused until it is:
profile.employmentSeguridadSocial: Your own Seguridad Social on the salary
profile.previousYearNetAmount: Last year's rendimiento neto (negative after a loss)
profile.first: First period with a positive net
profile.retenciones: Clients: EU businesses and US clients only, who withhold no retención and pay no IVA.
profile.projectionHint: What the months of alta in the tax year are expected to invoice and spend. No closed quarter is recorded yet, so this covers the whole year.
profile.projectionGastos: Expected gastos, without the RETA cuota
profile.baseCotizacion: Monthly base de cotización you pay
profile.saved: Saved. The overview now estimates from this profile.

errors.amount: An amount in euros like 1234.56: digits and a decimal point with at most two decimals, zero or more.
errors.signedAmount: An amount in euros like 1234.56 with at most two decimals, or -1234.56 after a loss.

failure.network: The GestorIA API is not answering. Start it and try again.
failure.database: The GestorIA database is not answering. Start it with docker compose up -d postgres and try again.
failure.invalid: The API refused the profile. The fields it refused are marked.
failure.other: The API answered with an error ({status}). Try again.

data.heading: Your data
data.export: To keep a copy, download it first on the
data.nothing: Nothing is stored on this installation.
data.deleted: Everything was deleted. Nothing about you is stored on this installation any more.

delete.heading: Delete all my data
delete.what: This deletes, from the GestorIA database on this machine:
delete.profile: your taxpayer profile for {year} ({region}): salary, autónomo registration and the year's projection
delete.transactions: every bank movement imported from your statements
delete.irreversible: It cannot be undone. GestorIA keeps no copy.
delete.retention: Spanish tax law expects you to keep the records behind each return for at least four years after its filing deadline, and ten years for a loss or deduction carried forward to later years (Ley General Tributaria, arts. 66, 66 bis, 67 and 70). If you still need them, download a copy first.

failure.network: The GestorIA API is not answering. Nothing was deleted. Start it and try again.
failure.other: The API answered with an error ({status}). Try again.
failure.database: The GestorIA database is not answering. Nothing was deleted. Start it with docker compose up -d postgres and try again.

Auth.title: Access
Auth.lead: The app is unlocked with the API key of your local installation.
Auth.unlocked: Unlocked. The key is kept in this tab's memory only: reloading or closing the tab locks the app again.

unlock.title: Unlock GestorIA
unlock.lead: Enter the API key of your local installation. It stays in this tab's memory only and is never saved.
unlock.refused: The API no longer accepts the key this tab was using. Enter the key again.
unlock.wrongKey: The API did not accept this key. Check it and try again.
unlock.unsendable: A key is made of Latin letters, digits and symbols. Check the keyboard layout and try again.
unlock.unreachable: The GestorIA API is not running.
unlock.unreachableNext: Start it from the project folder with this command, then try again:
unlock.database: The GestorIA API is running, but its database is not.
unlock.databaseNext: Start the database from the project folder with this command, then try again:
unlock.other: The API answered with an error ({status}). Try again.

Backup.title: Backup
Backup.lead: A copy of your data that lives outside this machine.

points.restore: Restoring your data from that file, so a lost laptop does not lose your tax history.

Backup.pending: Restore needs its own API resource, which is not built yet.

export.heading: Download all my data
export.lead: Everything GestorIA stores on this machine, in one JSON file you can keep elsewhere.
export.label: Personal financial data
export.care: The file holds your salary, your income, your autónomo registration and every bank movement you imported. Keep it where only you can open it, such as an encrypted drive or your password manager, and do not send it by email.
export.nothing: Nothing is stored yet, so there is nothing to download.
export.format: A JSON file named after today's date. Restoring from it arrives with the restore feature.
export.done: The file was handed to your browser as a download.

failure.gone: The profile is no longer stored, so there is nothing to download.
failure.other: The API answered with an error ({status}). Try again.
failure.database: The GestorIA database is not answering. Start it with docker compose up -d postgres and try again.
